title: Affine pushforward of the constructed increasing-tuple sheaf complex
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a separated scheme morphism, $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$ any finite family of affine opens, and $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. For the explicit sheaf complex $C$ [def-pc-s3-alternating-cech-sheaf-construction], there is an integer cochain-complex isomorphism $f_*(\operatorname{extend}C)\cong\operatorname{affineAlternatingCechModel}(f,U,G)$ [def-pc-affine-alternating-cech-model]. No covering condition or base change is assumed.

proof.text: Each nonempty tuple intersection W_t is affine, as X is separated over the affine base. Identify the intersection sheaf with j_* of G restricted to W_t by the term comparison. Pushforward composition and the tilde-Gamma counit identify f_*j_* of the restriction with tilde of Gamma(W_t,G), restricting scalars along f. The comparison is natural in inclusions of intersections.

Pushforward preserves products as a right adjoint. Tilde preserves finite products by additivity and preservation of finite coproducts. Taking the product of the component comparisons gives degreewise isomorphisms intertwining every signed face map. Their inverses commute with the differential by cancellation. Extend the resulting natural-degree complex isomorphism by zero to integers, compatibly with the additive functors. Empty tuple types give zero objects on both sides.
